audit_method: Same-agent exact comparison against the frozen source, surrounding definitions, displayed examples and proof invariants within that revision. No claim about current upstream master is made.

corrections.finding: The source's compound 'single-two place relation' is malformed and obscures that the language needs one two-place relation.
corrections.handling: Rendered the intended phrase as one two-place relation and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The language of set theory described here has one binary membership relation, and the following examples interpret exactly one binary relation symbol.

corrections.finding: The existential branch stops after 'for at least one m in the domain' while only the universal branch contains the displayed satisfaction claim.
corrections.handling: Restored the deliberately informal satisfaction expression B(m) in both conditional branches and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The surrounding paragraph contrasts the invalid B(m) paraphrase with assignment-relative satisfaction for both primitive quantifier profiles.

corrections.finding: The assignment suffix [s] is attached to the interpreted relation instead of only to the satisfaction judgement.
corrections.handling: Removed [s] from the relation interpretation and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: A structure alone fixes the interpretation of R; the assignment supplies values for variables in the atomic formula.

corrections.finding: Two formulas open two parentheses after negation but close only one, making the displayed formulas unbalanced.
corrections.handling: Used one balanced parenthesis pair around the disjunction in both formulas and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: Negation applies to the single parenthesized disjunction in the derived existential definition and in the immediately preceding line.

corrections.finding: A prose comma is placed inside the existential formula's argument immediately before the satisfaction suffix.
corrections.handling: Removed the comma from the mathematical expression and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The comma is not part of the formula grammar and the displayed judgement is a complete sentence punctuated after [s].

corrections.finding: For m=2,3,4 the source declares the consequent R(a,x) false, although at m=2 it is true; the intended false antecedent is R(x,a).
corrections.handling: Restored the false antecedent R(x,a) and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The implication is R(x,a) -> R(a,x), and the relation listed for the example makes its antecedent false at m=2,3,4.

corrections.finding: The second interesting case is printed as '= 2' with its variable omitted.
corrections.handling: Restored m before the equality and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The outer universal quantifier is evaluated by m, and the next paragraph explicitly handles the m=2 assignment.

corrections.finding: The summary quantifies over n although both cases and the entire preceding outer-quantifier analysis use m.
corrections.handling: Changed the summary metavariable to m and added an adjacent keyed note.

mathematical_delta.removed: for all n in Domain M
mathematical_delta.added: for all m in Domain M

corrections.controlling_evidence: m is the value assigned to the outer x, whereas n is used only for the inner y witness.

corrections.finding: The concluding tuple starts at t_i, leaving i free instead of listing the components from t_1 through t_k.
corrections.handling: Restored t_1 as the tuple's first component and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The preceding tuple and componentwise equality both range over all indices 1 through k.

corrections.finding: Both variant assignments are constructed from an undefined s instead of from the two assignments s_1 and s_2 compared in the proof.
corrections.handling: Constructed s_1' from s_1 and s_2' from s_2, then added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The independence proof compares s_1 and s_2 and immediately calls the resulting assignments their respective x-variants.

corrections.finding: Gamma is printed twice in the opening noun phrase, once as the subject and again after 'set of sentences'.
corrections.handling: Removed the redundant second occurrence and added an adjacent keyed note.

mathematical_delta.added: Gamma is a set of sentences

corrections.controlling_evidence: The definition introduces one set Gamma and the following clauses use that same set throughout.
